summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his third cycle of high-dose methotrexate reinduction therapy for recurrent primary central nervous system lymphoma. He tolerated the chemotherapy well, with no acute infusion reactions. His symptoms of ataxia and dizziness continued to improve, and his neurological exam was stable at discharge. Methotrexate levels cleared appropriately to 0.06 by discharge, allowing safe termination of leucovorin rescue. Transaminitis occurred as expected and began to resolve. Hypokalemia was managed with IV supplementation, and GERD was managed with a temporary switch to ranitidine. He was discharged home in stable condition with plans to continue outpatient rituximab and return for his next chemotherapy cycle in two weeks.
problems: Primary central nervous system lymphoma, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites
